label: rem:q-harmonic-basis-brane
title: $q$-Harmonic basis of the brane tower
html:
Remark. q-Harmonic basis of the brane tower

For each level n, the q-harmonic 1-forms \alpha_{n,i} belong to the space \mathcal{H}^1(\mathcal{S}_n, \mathrm{ad} \mathcal{S}_n) of harmonic 1-forms on \mathcal{S}_n with values in the adjoint bundle \mathrm{ad} \mathcal{S}_n. They are characterised by the self-duality condition relative to the instanton connection A_n (recursive brane tower):

  \alpha_{n,i} \in \mathcal{H}^1
  \iff
  d_{A_n}\alpha = 0
  \quad\text{and}\quad
  d_{A_n}^*\alpha = 0.

The Hodge-star operator is induced by the Hermitian metric that the Levi form L (substrate parameter) defines on the horizontal distribution. The index i runs over 1 \leq i \leq b_1(\mathcal{S}_n) (Betti numbers on branes).

At the base level n = 0 the index range above gives b_1(\mathcal{S}_0) = 3, hence three primary basis vectors \{\phi_1, \phi_2, \phi_3\}. At level n = 1 the basis lifts: it includes the original modes together with their J^1 prolongations (jet prolongation), which act as the first-order resolutions of the base flows.
